checkpoint.summary: Change 024 planned from the real Phase-10 dogfood finding. The repair is intentionally narrow: keep SOL_STALLED excluded from RunStore.getActiveRun(), but let LoopService terminally reconcile the latest exact-matching SOL_STALLED run from a strictly correlated durable Sol-control marker only when no newer active campaign exists. Allowed stalled-run decisions are GOAL_COMPLETE/BLOCKED/NEEDS_HUMAN; PAUSED remains rejected. The change also requires focused protection against wrong run/iteration/dispatch, newer-run mutation, actor resurrection, and duplicate application. Planning artifacts are committed; implementation and execution verification remain pending.
